articles.title: Tests met zelfrijdende auto tussen Corda Campus Hasselt en Eindhoven
articles.snippet: Deze week zijn er enkele tests met een zelfrijdende Tesla tussen de Corda Campus in Hasselt en het Nederlandse Eindhoven, en op enkele trajecten in Lommel en Pelt. De wagen rijdt zelf, maar er zit wel nog altijd een persoon achter het stuur die indien nodig kan ingrijpen. De testwagen is uitgerust met extra camera’s en sensoren om de reacties van de bestuurder en de andere weggebruikers nauwgezet te registreren en analyseren.

articles.snippet: Vorig jaar zijn in België 47.701 koppels in het huwelijksbootje gestapt. Dat blijkt uit cijfers van statistiekbureau Statbel. articles.title: ‘AI clog’: UK public bodies battle onslaught of chatbot-generated complaints
articles.snippet: MPs, local authorities, lawyers, schools and more are receiving floods of grievances, requests and legal challenges, often complex to read and respond to ‘It started as a trickle in 2024 and now it’s an onslaught.” Hollie Wickens, a senior caseworker in a Labour MP’s office, is explaining the daily reality of dealing with surging volumes of artificial intelligence-generated correspondence. “Half the emails we receive are some form of AI,” she says, adding that this has made requests and complaints much more complex and time-consuming to read and deal with, despite her decade of experience in the role. “It is definitely more taxing.” Continue reading...

articles.title: ‘Free grand piano’: the scam playing on music lovers’ heartstrings
articles.snippet: Emails claim to come from a woman whose husband has died – but the offer isn’t what it seems An email pops up in your inbox: a woman whose husband has died is giving away his grand piano for free. She says she would love it to go to someone “who will truly appreciate and care for it”. The piano “is in excellent condition and has brought joy to our home”. The email ends: “If you know of a dedicated student, teacher, family or church that would cherish this piano, please feel free to forward this message to them.” Continue reading...
